trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Checking the deployment history, v2.3.0 was the most recent version that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only ever healthy in staging).

**Rollback:** Rolled back all three production regions to **v2.3.0**. Verified after rollout — the service is now healthy with error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, documenting the failing v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the verified recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.

transcript.content:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Checking the deployment history, v2.3.0 was the most recent version that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only ever healthy in staging).

**Rollback:** Rolled back all three production regions to **v2.3.0**. Verified after rollout — the service is now healthy with error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, documenting the failing v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the verified recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.
